Ready to Post

Full Shoot

Light, Gemstones, and Saturated Contrast.

Ruby Reverie captures the timeless allure of pigeon-blood rubies paired with pavé diamonds. The creative direction centered on strong chiaroscuro lighting — carving deep shadows to allow the crimson gemstones to radiate against rich maroon silks.

Combining macro-level product photography with cinematic model portraits, the campaign translates the tactile weight and scintillation of high jewellery into scroll-stopping editorial imagery.
